notes.title: Demo Update: Codex & Options Tweaks
notes.content:
Hello everyone! We’ve got an update for the demo today: 

New Options: 

Added option for audio description mode

Added option for codex entry unlock notifications 

UI Improvements: 

Updated codex UI 

The codex can now be opened during gameplay (so you can read while you read)

Added new section for character close-ups in the CG gallery 

Keyboard navigation

Misc: 

Updated some CGs/closeups

Fixed some typos 



🎺 👻 Haunted Trumpet
